the chicken proximal tubule is capable of active urate secretion and that the secretion is sensitive to inhibition by several compounds that are also known inhibitors of organic anion transport in mammals.
the avian renal proximalepithelium actively secretes urate, and that the uricosuric effect of estrone sulfate is due to a combination of inhibition of urate uptake and stimulation of urate secretion.
urate secretion in chicken renal proximal tubules is mediated by organic anion transport proteins, and that the transport proteins are on the apical (luminal) membrane.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of the organic anion transport system that mediates urate secretion by the chicken kidney and the characterization of its properties.
the development of an in vitro model for the avian proximal tubule, which will allow the study of the mechanisms of renal urate transport in this important avian model.
the identification of transporters involved in urate secretion.
